entries.affected_because: Update deletes released requests from pendingReadIndex (read_only.go:100-104); the pending map and queue now describe the same set.
Released contexts can now be enqueued again (read_only.go:52-58 after read_only.go:100-104); FIFO advance must still see each context at most once.

A released context can be pending again in the same term, so recvAck (read_only.go:64-73) can count an acknowledgement produced for an earlier instance; the old count-only formula cannot tell instances apart.
entries.note: ReadDeliveryJustified is retained in base as a weaker control (implied by the new property); it accepts the forbidden trace state (E2), so it is not credited as update coverage.

Unaffected core safety property kept enabled in every update cfg as a control.
